parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing exposure is documented: no criminalisation (repealed 1791), no facility or border restriction, no police targeting, no state threat-framing. Positives are documented and in force — anti-discrimination protection covering public establishments, simple legal gender recognition, an openly gay head of government, a Pride tradition, an equality ministry, and HRT coverage. Deductions come from incomplete bias-crime enforcement (no hate-crime classification system, raw unclassified incident counts), microaggressions underreported through fear, and one transphobic column — friction and thin remedy, not hostility or universal exposure. Resident-facing items (youth care, school bullying) are climate signals only. Open questions (border document treatment, custody/ward placement) are unanswered, not exposures. Absence of a denominator or 2024 data limits, but does not worsen, the violence assessment.
